title: Bootstrap reproducible baseline and Forge Lite contracts
objective: Commit the recovered F0 kernel with reproducible CI, security boundaries, and durable Forge work/checkpoint contracts.
forbidden_actions: read or reuse credentials from chat
commit directly to a protected baseline
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action

acceptance_criteria.description: Build and agent control documents are present and internally consistent.
Unit tests, contract validation, secret scan, schema drift check, and wheel build pass in CI.

protected_actions: configure repository visibility or branch protection
approve or merge the pull request
